rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_C2
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS with common JA3 fingerprints"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        tags = "c2, beacon, cobaltstrike"
    strings:
        $x509_subject = "C=US, ST=California, L=San Francisco, O=Fastly, OU=CDN" // Common in C2 certs
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $uri_patterns = "/news.php" wide ascii
        $jarm_fingerprint = { 0002ad2f25d2dcd000000000000000a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5 }
    condition:
        all of them
}
